description: Poll the UI until a condition holds, then record the latest snapshot (same caching as snapshot_ui - refs from the result are usable directly). With textContains/resourceId: waits for a matching element to appear (or disappear, if gone:true). With neither: waits for the hierarchy to stop changing between polls ("settled").

gone.description: Wait for absence instead of presence. Default false.

name: wait_for_ui
title: Wait For UI
